summary: Two weeks before Taxifi's March 1 launch, David DiNardo demos the feature that lets self-employed users upload their 2024 T1 so OCR fills in their profile and business details automatically. He explains the four onboarding steps for a sole proprietor, why users should get their prior return and bank connection ready before signing in, and the founders-rate waitlist discount.
takeaways: Taxifi onboarding for a sole proprietor has four steps in year one: complete your profile, set up your business, connect your bank for income and expenses, and authorize the CRA.
Uploading your 2024 tax return lets OCR pull the profile and business fields automatically, so you do not answer questions or fill in forms; you just verify what the system found.
Before you sign in, get your prior-year return from your accountant or download it from Wealthsimple or TurboTax so you are not searching mid-session.
With last year's return and a bank connection in hand, David says the whole tax process should take under 15 minutes, likely under 10.
Bookkeeping is done by a human training the AI model, with the goal of fully automating bank-statement categorization so users never print 12 months of statements for an accountant again.
Joining the waitlist at taxifi.ai gives $100 off, a 50% discount, and locks in the founders rate for the first year.
